method: Contemporary airport name BORISPOL controls physical location; printed IEV is the city heading. OurAirports supplies approximate airfield coordinates. All previous airport objects are unchanged.

airports.name: Kiev–Borispol (1986)
airports.location_note: Air France no. 25 printed page 68 gives city KIEV / IEV but explicitly names the physical airport BORISPOL 38 KM. This is KBP/Borispol, not IEV/Zhulyany. Classified in the historical USSR; Europe/Kyiv supplies UTC+3 for February/March 1986. Modern coordinates mark the approximate airfield, not a reconstructed 1986 terminal, gate or aircraft position.
